- Initial release of the warden-agent-builder skill.
- Enables building and deploying original LangGraph agents for the Warden Protocol Agentic Wallet ecosystem.
- Clear distinction: users must create NEW, original agents (not replicas of community examples) to participate in the incentive programme or to be eligible for publishing.
- Comprehensive documentation provided, including best practices, example agent patterns to study (but not copy), and a detailed step-by-step guide for building and deploying a unique agent.
- Covers technical requirements, supported workflows, and security limitations for agent development.
